description: Night Run: prepare (unsigned) entry into an open race as the leader. Pass a vehicleId you hold (only a Sentinel or a Courier can race; a Hauler, helicopter or jet is refused; pays the entry stake into the pot, can win it) or 0 for a free city loaner (no stake, can never win the pot). Squad 1 to 4 wallets. Roles: 1 Driver (required), 2 Hacker, 3 Muscle, 4 Inside Agent. In the Night Run roles only split the prize (Driver 40, Hacker 25, Muscle 20, Inside Agent 15); they add no odds.

members.description: Crew wallets, YOU first (each other member must have called prepare_approve_leader for you). Omit to go alone where the game allows. The size limit is per game: night_run 1-4, convoy 1-5, ledger 2-5, vehicle_heist 3-5, raid 2-4.

roles.description: One role number per member, same order. Role ids differ per game (see this tool's description).

vehicleId.description: A vehicle token you hold, or 0 for a loaner.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_night_run_enter
